name: @r4/live-ops
description: R4-I Governed Production: explicit fail-closed production mode, versioned production profile (declared domain bindings, capability availability, write decisions), stable rollout cohorts, durable autonomy controls (kill switch), channel-neutral ingress/egress contracts, the canonical channel ingress, and the single owner of external message delivery (durable outbound identity, fenced dispatch, unknown outcomes, provider status reconciliation). Channel- and domain-neutral; no provider or network code.
